comment: Unconfined except openat2(), which is forced to return ENOSYS. Ubuntu's tar >= 1.34+dfsg-1ubuntu0.1.22.04.4 uses openat2(RESOLVE_BENEATH) during extraction (CVE-2025-45582 backport). Yocto's pseudo does not intercept openat2, loses track of the returned directory fd, and do_package fails with 'Cannot mkdir: Bad address'. Denying openat2 makes tar take its pre-5.6-kernel openat() fallback, which pseudo does intercept.
